Nearby devices
To connect to your sārathi dash over Bluetooth. The app only talks to the dash you pair; it never scans for other devices.
Notifications
Android shows a small ongoing notification while the dash is connected, so you can see the link is running and stop it.
Location
Navigation needs your position during the ride. It stays on this phone and the dash; the dash only ever gets it as distances from the start of the ride.
Location: allow all the time
Your phone stays locked in your pocket for the whole ride. Choose \"Allow all the time\" so navigation keeps working with the screen off, and comes back by itself if Android restarts the app.
Battery
Let the app run without battery restrictions, so Android doesn\'t stop the link to the dash mid-ride. It uses little battery while connected.
Pair with your dash
Turn the dash on nearby. Pick \"sarathi\" in the list, then compare the 6-digit code on the phone and on the dash: if they match, turn the knob to Pair and click.
Music on the dash
Turn on notification access for sārathi, so the dash can show what\'s playing and skip tracks. sārathi only reads the playing music; it doesn\'t read or keep other apps\' notifications.
Calls on the dash
See who\'s calling on the dash, and answer or reject with the knob. sārathi doesn\'t read your contacts or call log; the name comes from the call notification your phone already shows.

Nothing OS: Settings, Apps, sārathi, Battery: Unrestricted. Don\'t swipe the app away from Recents during a ride.
Samsung: Settings, Apps, sārathi, Battery: Unrestricted. Also Settings, Battery, Background usage limits: take sārathi off \"Sleeping apps\" and \"Deep sleeping apps\".
Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO: Settings, Apps, sārathi: Autostart on, Battery saver: No restrictions. In Recents, long-press sārathi and lock it.
OnePlus: Settings, Apps, sārathi, Battery: Unrestricted (or \"Allow background activity\"). In Recents, lock sārathi.
OPPO, realme: Settings, Apps, sārathi, Battery: allow background activity and auto launch. In Recents, lock sārathi.
vivo, iQOO: Settings, Battery, Background power consumption: allow sārathi. Settings, Apps, sārathi: Autostart on.
Huawei, Honor: Settings, Battery, App launch: sārathi to \"Manage manually\" with all three switches on.
Pixel: the Battery step above is enough.
If the link stops mid-ride, look for battery or background settings for sārathi on this phone and allow it to run unrestricted.
